scripts.api-build-spec: cd docs && node ./spec/build-api-spec.js && swagger-cli validate build/api-docs-output.yaml
scripts.api-docs-export-page: redoc-cli bundle docs/build/api-docs-output.yaml --title 'devopness API' --output public/index.html --cdn true
scripts.api-docs: npm run api-build-spec && npm run api-convert-spec-to-dredd && npm run api-docs-export-page && dredd --dry-run
scripts.api-docs-serve: npm run api-docs && redoc-cli serve docs/build/api-docs-output.yaml --port 9090 --title 'Devopness API docs'
